investigations.canonicalName: AGSM AIM SMART SOLUTIONS S.R.L. / Magis Smart

officialEvidence.finding: Magis launched the new e-mobility platform for 275 charging points and explicitly revised the tariff model; pay-per-use cost varies by kWh consumed and AC/DC charger type.

Current FAQ states pay-per-use price is calculated from tariffs shown in the app at time of use; subscriptions are separately deterministic: AC Small 0.60 EUR/kWh + 5 EUR/month, Medium 0.58 + 10, Large 0.50 + 20; DC Flat 0.74 EUR/kWh + 10 EUR/month, with combined plans.
Terms distinguish native Magis subscriptions from roaming and expose post-charge penalty rules; roaming tariffs are station-specific and must not be treated as direct CPO pricing.

investigations.tariffModel: direct pay-per-use price displayed in app at time of use; subscription grid deterministic and separate
investigations.tariffChannel: Magis E-mobility direct; roaming eMSP separate

fees.note: terms provide connector/time applicability; direct energy price still app-resolved

investigations.blockage: Current standard pay-per-use energy tariff is not published as a deterministic numeric network grid; app station/connector payload is required.
investigations.resumeCondition: Resolve Magis E-mobility guest/app backend and map ASS EVSE/connector to exact current pay-per-use price.
negativePaths: Do not substitute subscription prices for standard pay-per-use.
Do not use roaming tariffs as physical CPO direct pricing.

officialEvidence.finding: NRG4YOU currently advertises charging-station services but publishes no current public network-wide charging tariff.
Official Restation portal exposes public station search but no tariff values in the public station listing.
Portal registration/account flow confirms user/account-gated workflow for service use.

investigations.blockage: Exact current tariff is not exposed in public station listing and cannot be generalized from stale individual station examples.
investigations.resumeCondition: Obtain Restation station detail/session payload exposing exact current tariff and join NRG EVSE IDs deterministically.
negativePaths: Do not generalize older third-party 0.60 EUR/kWh station examples.

officialEvidence.finding: ZapGrid by G.M.T. describes its operator management platform as customizable and designed to give station managers control over their charging stations; this is incompatible with assuming one GMT-wide tariff without station mapping.

investigations.tariffChannel: ZapGrid hosted direct station pricing; roaming separate
investigations.blockage: No current deterministic G.M.T.-wide price grid; hosted networks may use different prices.
investigations.resumeCondition: Resolve public/guest ZapGrid station endpoint and map GMT EVSE to hosted operator/site tariff.
negativePaths: Do not generalize known individual ZapGrid hosted-network examples to all GMT EVSE.

evidence.finding: Coop Power stations built with Nucleo were reported at 0.39 EUR/kWh AC 22 kW and from 0.49 EUR/kWh DC 160 kW, with direct card/Charge Assist payment.

investigations.tariffChannel: direct card/Charge Assist on mapped Coop Power sites; other Nucleo sites unresolved
investigations.blockage: Coop Power pricing is evidence for a specific Nucleo subnetwork, not proof for the full 160-EVSE CPO scope; exact EVSE-to-subnetwork mapping is required and current 2026 price continuity must be verified before promotion.
investigations.resumeCondition: Map CPO EVSE to Coop Power stations and verify current per-station Charge Assist/direct tariff payload.
negativePaths: Do not generalize Coop Power tariffs to all Nucleo EVSE.
